name: Parity sweep
about: Check named features of docs/parity/FEATURES.md on this machine, one card per feature, then a handoff. Nothing is pushed, merged into main or installed.

steps.title: Check {{feature}} on this machine
steps.goal:
Check feature {{feature}} of docs/parity/FEATURES.md on this machine.

1. Run `npm run build:wrapper` on Windows first (the checks need it). The packages are already installed: never run `npm ci`.
2. Read the feature's section: its `what:` line and this machine's status line, including any `check:` text. If this machine's status is not `todo`, change nothing and say so.
3. Check it with the tests named there and, where the section asks for it, by the steps it describes. Do not start a live model session unless the section requires one.
4. If it works, change only this machine's status line of {{feature}} to `done <commit>` with a one-line note of how it was checked. If it does not, leave the status as it is and say what failed.
5. Fix a bug you find only when the fix stays inside {{feature}}; commit it with the status change.

Never change the other machine's status line or any other feature's section, and never run `npm run install-global` or `npm run install-linux`.
steps.reply: {{feature}}: this machine's status line now, how it was checked, and the commit id (or what failed)

steps.title: Handoff for the user: {{features}}
steps.goal:
Every check card of this plan is merged into your branch. Read docs/parity/FEATURES.md for {{features}} and `git log` of this branch.

Change no file. Reply in under 150 words: which features are now `done` on this machine and how each was checked, which failed and why, and what the user has to do next.
